3D coefficient array class for storing interaction or rate data.

Convert all symbolic entries to numerical values using SymPy N.

Convert numeric matrix back to symbolic form.

class core_classes.Mat(arr, *args, **kwargs)¶

Top level class for all matrix like objects (Vectors, WMatrix, EqMatrix, …)

simp() → None¶

In-place symbolic simplification of the matrix.

class core_classes.TrMatrix(arr, *args, **kwargs)¶

Class handling all transition matrices. These matrices should sum to zero along columns and have positive off-diagonal elements.

add_trans(i: int, j: int, r: float | Expr = 1.0, ri: float | Expr | None = None, symm: bool = True, simp: bool = True) → None¶

Add a transition i –> j with rate r, and optionally symmetric transition j –> i.

Parameters:

  • i – (int) Start index

  • j – (int) Target index

  • r – (float | Expr) Transition rate from i to j

  • ri – (float | Expr | None) Optional inverse rate (j to i)

  • symm – (bool) If True, adds j –> i with rate 1/r or ri

  • simp – (bool) If True, simplifies r and ri

calc_diag() → None¶

Force recomputation of diagonal terms to preserve column sum = 0.

check_diag() → bool¶

Check if all columns sum to zero.

check_rates(verbose: bool = False) → bool¶

Check if all off-diagonal rates are non-negative.

core_classes.arr_to_mat(arr) → MutableDenseMatrix¶

Convert input array-like to sympy.Matrix. - Ensures proper shape. - Converts row vectors to column vectors.

Parameters:

arr – (array-like) Input data

Returns:

(Matrix) SymPy matrix

core_classes.check_diag(m: Mat, tol: float = 1e-15, err: bool = False) → bool¶

Check if each column in matrix m sums to zero.

Parameters:

  • m – (Mat) Matrix to check

  • tol – (float) Allowed numerical tolerance

  • err – (bool) Raise exception if check fails

Returns:

(bool) True if all columns sum to zero

core_classes.check_rates(m: Mat, err: bool = False, verbose: bool = False) → bool¶

Check that all off-diagonal elements are non-negative.

Parameters:

  • m – (Mat) Matrix to check

  • err – (bool) Raise exception on negative element

  • verbose – (bool) Log indeterminate cases due to symbolic expressions

Returns:

(bool) True if all off-diagonal elements are non-negative
